_README: APPROXIMATE / ROUGH SKETCH ONLY. These points and paths were hand-placed on Google Maps satellite imagery by the user to convey LAYOUT and ROUTING, not precise geometry. They are NOT survey data and NOT the actual driven line. DO NOT treat any coordinate, vertex, path shape, or length as exact. Google imagery coords also differ from the phone GPS by several meters. USE ONLY AS SEEDS: snap each landmark to the nearest point on the real phone GPS track and validate by data (gate via lap-time RMSE; pit exit/entrance via speed/heading). The two LineStrings are coarse few-vertex sketches of the pit-lane ROUTE (which side it loops), NOT a smooth or accurate path. Do not be literal.
